description:
Know which AI account needs attention before you hit a limit.

Vigil brings current quotas, reset times, balances, credits, billing data, spend, and provider-returned budget controls from your linked AI providers into one private dashboard on iPhone and iPad, plus widgets.

SEE THE IMPORTANT LIMIT FIRST
• Compare linked accounts in one place
• Open an account for provider-returned windows and reset times
• Keep a bounded local history of successful readings
• Pull to refresh whenever you need a current check

CHECK WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Add a small Home Screen widget
• Add a circular Lock Screen widget
• Hide usage values in widgets whenever you prefer
• Receive optional alerts at fixed 80% and 95% thresholds

PRIVATE BY CONSTRUCTION
Vigil has no collection server, analytics, advertising SDK, or cross-app tracking. Credentials are stored in the iOS Keychain. Usage data and history stay in the app's local container. Requests go directly from your device to providers you choose to connect. Notification details can be hidden, automatic checks can be paused, and Face ID can protect the app surface.

15 PROVIDER INTEGRATIONS
Connect Claude; ChatGPT / Codex; OpenRouter; DeepSeek; Moonshot global and China; MiniMax global and China; OpenAI API; GitHub Copilot; xAI API; Grok Build; Z.ai Coding Plan; Cursor; and Kimi K3. Experimental integrations are clearly labeled in the app.

LIGHT OR DARK, YOUR CHOICE
Choose System, Light, or Dark appearance—the original dark design remains fully available. Standard navigation and toolbar controls adopt the current native iOS visual treatment, while usage cards stay easy to read.

Vigil is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the listed providers. Metrics depend on what each provider returns and can vary by account, plan, region, and provider availability. An account with the relevant provider is required.
promotionalText: See your AI limits before they surprise you. Vigil keeps provider quotas, resets, balances, spend, and widgets together—direct from your device.
